meta.name: understand-domain
meta.description: Extract business domain knowledge from a codebase and generate an interactive domain flow graph. Works standalone (lightweight scan) or derives from an existing /understand knowledge graph.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从代码库提取业务领域知识并生成交互式流程图
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要从现有代码中梳理业务逻辑和领域模型
copy.tagline_en: Extract business domain knowledge from codebase and generate interactive flow graph
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to extract business logic and domain models from existing code

howto.what: 它会读取当前代码库,提取业务领域、业务流程和流程步骤,并生成一张可交互的横向领域流程图,默认在仪表盘中打开查看。项目里已有知识图谱时就直接从图谱派生,不再重复扫描。
howto.when: 当你执行 /understand-domain 时接管;已有知识图谱就直接派生,没有则做一次轻量扫描(文件树、入口点、抽样文件),加 --full 可强制重新扫描。

say.text: 运行 /understand-domain,把当前项目的业务领域梳理成流程图
say.note: 生成领域图并自动打开仪表盘

say.text: 项目里已有知识图谱,直接用它推导领域流程,别重扫
say.note: 跳过扫描,直接从图谱派生

howto.what_en: It reads the current codebase, extracts business domains, flows and process steps, and builds an interactive horizontal domain flow graph shown in the dashboard. If a knowledge graph exists, it derives from it instead of scanning.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you run /understand-domain. If a knowledge graph exists it derives from it; otherwise it runs a lightweight scan (file tree, entry points, sampled files). --full forces a fresh scan.

say_en.text: Run /understand-domain to map this project's business domains as a flow graph.
say_en.note: Builds domain-graph.json and opens the dashboard

say_en.text: Run /understand-domain --full to force a fresh scan before analyzing.
say_en.note: Ignores the existing knowledge graph and rescans

say_en.text: Use the existing knowledge graph to derive the domain flow; don't rescan.
